name: context-heavy-diagrams
description: Let Claude read, validate and create the diagrams (.chd files) and supporting documents in one folder you choose. Everything runs on your computer; whatever Claude reads is sent to Anthropic as part of the conversation.
long_description: Works with the diagrams made by Context-Heavy Diagrams. Claude can list the files in the folder you choose, read diagrams, notes and supporting documents, check a diagram for structural problems or against a diagram metamodel, show what changed in a diagram, and create new diagrams, notes and metamodels. Optionally, it can also modify existing files; if you allow that, an edit replaces the file, so keep your diagrams in version control. Claude can read any file in the chosen folder except executables, installers, archives, disk images, video and audio, but it can only write diagrams, notes and plain text files, and it can never touch anything outside the folder or dot-files such as .env. To show what changed since the last commit, the extension runs the read-only git command `git show` on one diagram; it starts no other program. That can bring back an earlier version of a diagram or note, including content you have since removed. This extension makes no network connections, but anything Claude reads is sent to its provider as part of the conversation, so do not point it at a folder with confidential material or history unless that is acceptable.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the files in the folder, or in one subfolder of it.

tools.name: get_format_spec
tools.description: The rules of the .chd diagram format.

tools.name: validate_diagram
tools.description: Check a .chd file for structural problems.

tools.name: validate_metamodel
tools.description: Check a .chdmeta file against the metamodel format.

tools.name: check_diagram
tools.description: Check a .chd file, or a draft as text, against a diagram metamodel.

tools.name: diff_diagrams
tools.description: See what changed in a diagram: between two files or drafts, or since a commit in git.

tools.name: edit_diagram
tools.description: Build or change a diagram step by step: add, connect, move, restyle, tag, link, note and delete elements, and learn what is wrong with the layout.

tools.name: inspect_diagram
tools.description: List the elements of a diagram with their positions and connection points.

tools.name: room_for_label
tools.description: How much space two connected elements need for an edge label.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file: text with its fingerprint, pictures as images, other binary files such as PDFs as attachments.

tools.name: update_file
tools.description: Replace an existing file (only if you allow modifying files).

diagram_folder.title: Diagram folder
diagram_folder.description: The one folder Claude may use. It can read the files in it (and its subfolders), except executables, installers, archives, disk images, video and audio, and create new diagrams, notes and text files. Anything it reads is sent to its provider.

allow_update.title: Allow Claude to modify existing files (can cause data loss)
allow_update.description: Off by default. When on, Claude can replace existing .chd, .md, .txt, .svg and .chdmeta files in the folder. An edit replaces the file with no backup, so keep your files in version control.
